summary: Rofecoxib was pulled from the market worldwide starting in 2004 because of heart harm [3]. A small computer model, not tests on people, estimated a high risk score of 80 for the liver and a low score of 12 for the heart [M]. A similar drug named Valdecoxib was also pulled from the market in the United States and three other countries due to serious skin reactions and heart harm [3]. At least one clinical study of rofecoxib was discontinued after its marketing approval was withdrawn [7].
